source_extracts.label: USPS 2026 extra services price list
source_extracts.quote: Certified Mail $5.55; Return Receipt (hardcopy, PS Form 3811) $4.65; Return Receipt Electronic $2.91; Restricted Delivery $14.35 — rates effective July 12, 2026 (verified 2026-10-22, prior receipt certified-mail-return-receipt-vs-carrier-signature)

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Return Receipt basics
source_extracts.quote: Return Receipt must be purchased at the time of mailing; shows recipient's signature, delivery date, and delivery address if different; PS Form 3811-A delivery-record copy available 90 days

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Certified Mail basics
source_extracts.quote: Certified Mail provides proof of mailing and delivery record; moves at the speed of the underlying mail class, not guaranteed

source_extracts.label: 2026 postage price change
source_extracts.quote: Forever stamp = 82 cents since July 12, 2026 (up from 78)

source_extracts.label: Ohio Revised Code 1923.04
source_extracts.quote: 3-day eviction notice may be given by certified mail, return receipt requested (one of several allowed methods)

source_extracts.label: Store services + hours
source_extracts.quote: Certified Mail offered; hours Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM-2:00 PM; 7554 Fredle Drive, Concord Township, OH 44077
